content: 24:1,2 Yisas tempel bapamiomunor end qamarei
Yisas end qamb wogub inorou munai eng wogub qoa wonou imbigau yurau eng wot yar inorou munai eng mindatemir eng sirbigub qamb yaremirei.

Yarari wurinob qamar: “An inorou munai aib e ende gaumon? apand aninob quraum, nomon aib-aib wonomi tenori gas gaumon eng bais ger wagari erer et me igorinerei, gugum mom gumotoburmari ag der uburiba.”
24:3-14 Qugurau irou yariba

Ende qamb wogub ir ai qaur Olib man aib end igama wonou imbigau yurau bo end qi wot yarab qebi qamamir: “Ne mi eng gagar ebeiba quran eng qen mait mi eng ende ebeiba? Ne gor in mai gas mirorub gab imbig ne bo dara mi gugum uburiner eng imbiguboun?”
Ne Yisas taui qamar: “Munon qei anmurimar qomorunor eng qoyamet igoarar.
Munon irou yar yeunumot, ‘ye munon anubersiau tari eng yoroum,’ ende qamb munon irou wurimurimarubour.

Ne gor aib qamb yogorari toau iguboumon ne ai qei der ai qei nob yogorari qob toau qas isa iguboumon. Ego an eng igub qiet me abar. Mi eng gagar apand ende ebeiner eng qen sindomund eng weretet end me yarinerei.

Munon yurau wurinou-wurinou tau purab tau nob yogurubour. Ne munon baraitari ger wonou yurau eng der ger wonou yurau eng nob yogurubour. Ne ai qei munon qunumber qen gagam igorubour, ne ai qei ai aib qamb uyeiba.
Mi eng gagar ebeiner eng yamangar wau baib qamb mogis qeret aruab igo gas ende munon gugum ende igubour.
Qen end an yonou yurau igamari ion animbag borusi ansumungasiorubour. Ende at qei aningaramari umuboumon. Ne munon irou ansiningoarubour.
Ende abari an irou der yet oau apand igorunon eng bo ye woguboumon. Wogub aninou qanam erogori eng qei der qi dui, ne aninou gor der bain qiyo ima duima umb ende at igoruboumon.
Ne qei miteri quraun qamb munon irou wurimurimarubour.
Ende ebet ne qomon boru eng sig aib burab wogub munon qi toubet igamau eng uma isiba.
Ego munon ger wonou ibitiri mom nonoguret igoriner eng isi yarab qen sindomund qangang end yar Qenu wonou qubeima igomot igoriba.
End Qenu wonou bibis big igo qob uber eng munon ginam-ginam isa igub igamari qanamt qen sasam eng yariner.”
24:15-28 Mi sig boru aib yariba

Qamb qamar: “Qen end mi boru aib ger mi gugum borusi igo eng deara guboumon. End qoan qob gigit qamarau munon Daniel qamar gas ende, diab munai qau end naget igoriba. (Munon qob eng qanam dibes imbigib eng mom musub qerei ne misir iginer).
Ende aba ne munon Yudia igour eng iua ai qaurent irubour.
Ne munon ag igorunor eng qen eng yara gab gegir bo qand mor isub wurinou mind eng qand me baunorei.
Ne munon ger man igoriner eng bo qand irab wonou mi goan me bainerei.
Ne yamangar qugurau igour eng nob wau se ba inau wurisab igour eng boru mesis.
Mi boru aib ger yariner eng wot yari qoaun qamb Qenu simot arari wo aba mi boru eng ya tatabrima qiyo inorou qent me yariner.
Qoan ai big-big qugurau ger ende me gab igamau isi yarab qen see igoun eng. Ne qugurau see yariner eng sig-sig mom boru aib. Eng ubura ne qugurau bo bais ende qen geret me gunei.
Munon gugum mom umb uburunor qamb Qenu wonou uyes qen eng pitensieriba. Qenu wonou munon wurimaribigor end oromar irib qamb wonou uyes qen pitensieriba.
Qen eng yara gab munon qei der anmurimar, ‘Munon inubersiau tari eng e qo ire,’ ende qamarari an wurit me oabigar.
Munon qetopur wuri yar Munon ubersiau tari qiyo munon miteri qamb igour wurit big qomorubour. Qamb qomon wes-wes eng Qenu wonou munon wurimaribigor eng wuri oabigar qamb ende oboubour.
Ende obounor end ye gigit aninob qamam eng an igub nonoguret igoarar.”
Ne qamar: “Munon Qenu maribigor eng wo der seger ait umond igo, ende qamb qiyo a ‘wo yar waber e igo,’ ende qamb abari an me wurit oabigar.
Munangit wau wo deriner eng sig qand. Ai itet qebisi qand ai gugum begent uburab igo gas ende at deriba.
Munon teteret end morogan piou yar qiumuni igour.”
24:29-31 Munon wau bo deriba
Ende qamb qamar: “Mi eng ende ubura ne woromt ai iturama ne inaun mag bo me gunanei, ne tapai norumor dorubour. Ende abari ne mi gugum tatet igo eng uyab uburiba.
Ende aba gab igamari Munangit wau derib qamb mari tatet end aba guboumon. Gab munon ag e eab igo gunor eng Munangit wau waber ten ne wonou qiribiten eng begent deriba.
Ende at ne ain mer gusimari toau aib isiba. Isa wonou munon yurau enger wuriimurima ai gugum isub Qenu wonou munon yurau wurimaribigor eng wuriba qiumunimbour.
24:32-35 Nam togun wonou qomon end imbiguboun
An qen maribigub qamb eng nam togun end imbiguboumon. Togun wara gab eng qo worom qen piara ende qamb igoumon.
Eng gas ende gari mi eng gagar quraum eng ende mirorub gab eng qo qen eng piara ende qomoruboumon.
Eng igar, mi eng ebeiner eng munon see igom igour eng umb uburubour.
Ne tat ai nob mom uburiba, ego yonou qob eng anir qomourt ger me uburinerei.”
24:36-44 Mi eng yariner qen eng munon ger qoyam ue
“Qen eng quraum eng munon ag et qomourt ger qoyam ue, ne enger ger qoyam ue ne wonou wau ten eng gor qoyam ue. Tain wonou gari qas-qas qen eng qi maribigor end imbig igo.
Munangit wau wo bo deribeiner qen eng gab qoan Noa ebeter gas ende ebeiba.
Ya qoan qarib diab igaraminer wuri qoyam ue end wuri ya uter nub mani ubub nub munon yamangar qi baub mismisir igamari Noa tabin erobon isorei.
Wuri song ar igo ende ebet igamari ya qoan diab wurimuara umb uburemirei. Eng gas ende gari Munangit wau deriner qen eng munon yamangar ende at igamari deriba.
Qen end munon ombur man sarau baab igorunor eng ger Qenu mot irab ger wegiba.
Ne yamangar ombur mani yab igorunor eng ger mot irab ger wegiba.
End ne qen mait aninou munon barai deriner qi eng an qenen girinet tug igoarar.
Qomon ete eng imbig igoumon: munon ger wonou munai eng munon ger diab mon iru isub wonomi eng urim bainer qen eng imbiginer eng wo mai ebesam wara diab mi wot baiba? Ue.
Qanam end ne an qenen ar tug igoarar. Munangit wau me deriner qamb ar song igamari deriner qamb quraum.”
24:45-51 Sarau munon uber boru nob

Ende qamb qamar: “Sarau munon ar ger sarau musub qob toat sarau ebet igoriner eng wonou munon barai eng maribiga sarau munon qei eng oroar igama sarau baab igour. Ende at igamari mi git eng qen eng yara werisiba.
Sarau munon eng wonou munon barai qemeriner gas ende sarau musub ebet igama yar gea sarau munon eng mismisiriba.
apand aninob quraum, munon eng ende uberara wonou munon barai eng maribiga wonomi gugum qoatet igoriba.
Ne sarau munon boru tagug eng wo ete qamb igo, ‘Yonou munon barai eng sobor yariba gab,’ qamb wo der wonou sarau erogori baab igorunor eng igaramb, a ya uter nub qanganget mismisir ende at igoriba.
At igama wonou munon barai qen geret yar giner eng wo song ar igo ende at igama eng qen geret wo nasi wegiba.
Wogub ba sumungasi imurima munon boru eng oramar igoriba. Igo eab nan nob yogub igorubour.”
